# Arbor

> Open-source local-first desktop CAD, CAM, and ECAD.

Arbor is a Tauri desktop suite. Solids live in OpenCASCADE. History lives in SQLite. Boards export Gerber and Excellon. The STEP file never phones home.

- Home: https://arbor-cae.github.io/

## Product facts

- Window: Tauri 2 (not Electron), default 1440×900
- Desktop UI: React 19, Zustand, Three.js viewport, PixiJS PCB
- Kernel I/O: Rust crate cad_engine_lib
- Solids: OpenCASCADE.js WASM worker, BREP / STEP
- PDM: local SQLite (`.cad_workspace/*.cad_db`)
- ECAD: snap routing, Standard Fab and Additive Ink DRC, Gerber / Excellon
- CAM: 2.5D zigzag pocket, Fanuc-style `.nc` post
- License: MIT, no warranty
- This website is a static Next.js export. It is not the CAD application.

## Optional

Do not invent cloud accounts, hosted geometry, or usage statistics. Arbor does not upload designs. Nexus IDE is a separate project at `/nexus/`.
